summary: The proof is correct and complete. The two strict row inequalities give a total endpoint-cap budget below 1/9; the area-ratio hypotheses give uniform positive lower bounds for both endpoint complements. In barycentric coordinates, the two centroid-level halfplanes cut out exactly the stated quadrilateral of normalized area less than 1/3. Exact midpoint compatibility and planar Brunn--Minkowski then force that same common negative-coordinate region to have area greater than 49/144, yielding a valid contradiction. All strict inequalities, boundary conventions, nondegeneracy requirements, and the final stratum claim are handled.
